name: Japanese Economic Association 2027 Autumn Meeting
submission_requirements: Only JEA members may present (non-members must first apply for membership); applications only via the member My Page; student members on the reduced fee may apply for poster presentations only; autumn presenters must pay the meeting-year membership fee by end of May. Whether English-language papers are accepted is not stated on the pages checked.
membership_required: Yes: JEA membership required to present
expected_note: Host and dates announced; call not yet open. The 2026 autumn application guide was posted in early March 2026, but its deadline could not be read (PDF not accessible), so this date is a rough placeholder, not a shifted known deadline.
